verdict.rationale: Stripe Identity documents its own test-mode flow in which you submit a session by picking a predefined test case, including failure cases such as declined consent or refused camera permissions. This runs inside Stripe's isolated sandbox, and results are reviewable in the test dashboard. However, the test cases live only inside the integration guide, and the evidence does not show that every outcome, notably a manual-review result, can be produced deterministically. missing for 10: documented test case or magic value producing a review/requires-input outcome, a standalone exhaustive catalog of test documents/personas covering every verification result, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, a sandbox lets me exercise every outcome before going live — documented test documents, personas, or magic values that deterministically produce pass, fail, and review results

citations.quote: Submit the session by selecting a predefined test case
A sandbox is an isolated test environment.
